differs.layout: Hero scale: a big three-line headline holds the top left while one long flume sweeps across the rest of the frame (top run, plunge, loop-the-loop, hairpin, return run) into one wide Paid pool under the headline, instead of copy beside a staircase of four ramps and five pools.
differs.data: One figure, the share of visitors who pay (6%, from 60 of 1,000), instead of four stage counts and three drop-off pools.
differs.mechanic: A single large rider per loop rides the whole course with simulated speed (slow push-off, fast plunge, slowing over the loop top) and a ballistic jump off a lip, instead of a stream of a hundred small riders hopping ramp to ramp.
differs.moment: The splash into the Paid pool: a jet and spray go up, a wave runs across the water and the big 6% rises out of the pool on it and floats there, instead of counters ticking and pools filling.

blurb: One rider rides a single long slide with a loop-the-loop into the Paid pool, and its splash lifts the share of visitors who pay out of the water.
